tools.name: generate_natal_chart
tools.description: Generate a natal (birth) chart given birth date, optional time, and location. Returns calculated chart text: planetary positions, plus Rising sign and houses only when a birth time is given.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "generate_natal_chart" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Generate a natal (birth) chart given birth date, optional time, and location. Returns planetary positions, houses, aspects, and astrological insights." → after: "Generate a natal (birth) chart given birth date, optional time, and location. Returns calculated chart text: planetary positions, plus Rising sign and houses only when a birth time is given."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
